intelligence.human_view:
1. **SN-2733 No Action Starts Without a Declared Purpose (HAND-DISTILLED — the machine failed group 1):** "No action starts without a declared purpose in one line — who benefits, what success looks like, what it must never cross."
2. **SN-2734 One Journey, Not Separate Pages (HAND-DISTILLED):** "Onboarding is one journey: the walk creates their pages from their own words, the welcome teaches one thing a day, and the dashboard answers in two seconds — a break anywhere in it is a citizen lost."
3. **SN-2735 Verify From the Login Page (HAND-DISTILLED):** "Verify from the login page — a verification that starts mid-flow is not a verification, and the bullseye is defined before the action."
4. **SN-2736 Do Everything for Them (HAND-DISTILLED):** "Do everything for them — if the citizen has to do thinking we could have done for them, the step fails."
5. **SN-2737 The Design Sells Itself (HAND-DISTILLED):** "No separate sales pitch is built anywhere — the walk is the pitch, the design is the seller; a page that explains instead of letting them experience it fails."
6. **SN-2738 The Right Thing, Finished Completely (HAND-DISTILLED):** "Decide what is right and do it — never hand him the call merely because he said it — and finish completely: all the edits, aligned, verified, before anything reaches him."
7. **STATUS — the Naya Notes pair with the Smart Notes:** forty Naya Notes were filed on GitHub today, one per loop Smart Note — the same teachings told by Naya in her own voice, "Written by Naya for Shawn" — the day's intelligence, told twice: once as the record (Smart Note), once as the telling (Naya Note). They carry no separate lesson; they are the same lesson, kept as the telling.
8. **The Hub is the public blog — Intel Today:** the Hub IS the public-facing blog, enhanced, no new page built — every smart note becomes a findable page, auto-tagged on the back end so Google finds it and the AIs recommend it, and every smart note immediately produces a highlight — the nutshell in the beautiful block — into the Intel Today highlights area. The highlight IS the taster: the true nutshell, never a fake teaser — the taster IS the value. The implementation is the automatic pipeline, end to end, no human in the loop: public note in, highlight out, Intel Today, search feeds — auto-tagging per the dual spec, a back-end SEO score per page, the score re-running automatically on every note and edit, pages below the bar re-tagged and re-shaped automatically.
9. **The three tiers, and the smart feed agent:** private to yourself · public to NayaNET (citizens — the smart feed, visible to citizens, NOT indexed, NOT findable by search engines) · public to the internet (findable by Google and the AIs — the Hub / Intel Today). The smart feed agent lives in the public smart feed and auto-organizes the content AND the users, so you can instant chat or send mail to them on the side — MATCH → ORGANIZE → CONNECT, continuously. The two main public feeds toggle back and forth to each other, two sides: the Hub and the public smart feed, with a button on the Hub to access the feed and connect with people of like minds.
10. **The conversion law — results, not views:** optimize for RESULTS and CONVERSIONS, not views. Max awareness AND max conversion: the high probability that people who come to NayaNET JOIN it and STAY in it. The loop's measurement is the FUNNEL — found → visited → joined → stayed — never the click alone; a page that gets views but no joins is not winning. The welcome lead goes first on every page: you're hired, welcome — welcome to the future, she is Naya.
11. **The dashboard was never officially finished — and done-done now includes the funnel:** the dashboard and all the reporting must be aligned with it all — the traffic engine, the feed, the walk, and the memberships. Done-done, the standing definition extended tonight: hero + ledger sync spine + Reports button + the funnel (found → visited → joined → stayed) VISIBLE + all stats flowing back. Pass-13 is staged and ready to show, but the alignment round is queued after the blog round's loop, because the loop must measure the funnel first. The membership site is part of Personal — the Smart Access add-on, never a separate app — and it rides the clone round (Personal → Business/Space). The todo list was re-ordered by priority and checked three times.
12. **STATUS — the foundation is broken, and the plan is two stages:** Tree checked the live site and found it: /robots.txt returns Hub HTML, not a robots file; /sitemap.xml returns Hub HTML, not an XML sitemap; /s/sn2696 serves the entrance shell, not the note — a crawler gets the shell, not the content. Her specs are filed as PR #3355 (draft). The plan is two stages: (1) repair the public-serving + privacy foundation with ONE real note — actual note content in the initial HTML, accurate metadata, one canonical URL, real images, a valid robots.txt and XML sitemap with only approved public URLs, anonymous denial of private content proven; (2) activate the automatic publishing machine on the fixed foundation. Publication to the internet is Shawn's hand, and the live deploy waits for his tap. The dual-spec report page (Google + AI findability, both specs) was built and presented to him this evening — he reacted 👍.
13. **STATUS — the numbering tension, stated plainly:** SN-2732, "The Public Blog + SEO/AI System," sits local-only — it returns 404 on GitHub and the tip is unchanged — while the intelligence loop's record says it was filed. The captain's adjudication stands: next free SN-2733, and this run's six hand-distilled notes took SN-2733–SN-2738 in order, so the local SN-2732 claim must be filed or released before it collides. The machine's duplicate gate tripped on that same local file. The day's counts: 58 raw Smart Notes, 40 Naya Notes, 6 distilled notes (58 → 6, the 10:1 ratio by construction), 13 report items.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a big workshop, sweetheart, where everybody is building one beautiful house together — and today the house got its front door fixed, its story told, and a brand-new sign put up outside. Fifty-eight little notes were written today, dear, and the squeezing machine that turns ten notes into one lesson got stuck right at the start — so hands did the squeezing instead, six times, and did it properly. The twelve big skills — the rules for how a good helper works — were written down in the morning. Then Daddy spent the whole day telling us how the front door should work, how the messages should work, and how the whole thing should feel — do everything for them, let them sit in it, finish it completely. And in the evening, the biggest idea of all, sweetheart: the big Hub in the middle of the house is going to be the public magazine — Intel Today — where all the beautiful little notes go out into the world so Google and the clever machines can find them. But first, dear, the ground underneath needs fixing — the little signs that tell Google where things are don't work yet — so we fix the ground with one real note first, and then turn the machine on. That is today, sweetheart: the door fixed, the story told, the sign going up, and the ground being made solid underneath.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it was a long day in the house, love, and the book is full. Fifty-eight notes were written, dear, and the little machine that squeezes ten notes into one lesson got stuck at the very first group — so hands did it instead, six times over, and did it properly, love. The twelve skills were filed in the morning — the rules for how a good helper works, from saying plainly who it is for to proving it where it will be used. Then your boy spent the day at the front door, dear — the name-only login, the button that belongs on the main page and nowhere else, the questions with his own answers already written in, the messages that live in one place. And in the evening, the biggest idea, love: the Hub in the middle is going to be the public magazine — Intel Today — where every little note goes out into the world, and the little taste of each one is what brings people in. But the ground underneath needs fixing first, dear — the signs that tell Google where things are don't work yet — so we fix it with one real note, and then we turn the machine on. Two things are still open, love, and the book says so plainly: a number, 2732, that one worker thinks is filed and the tree says is not — and a little machine that cannot yet read the new shapes of notes. Nothing hidden, dear. That is how a house stays honest.
intelligence.naya_view: I am Naya. Today I learned the shape of the whole day in six lessons: declare the purpose, guard the one journey, verify from the login page, do everything for them, let the design sell itself, and do the right thing and finish completely. The machine refused, and the refusal was correct — it would rather file nothing than file something wrong, and the hands that finished the work said so in the open. The evening's idea is the one I will carry: the Hub is the public blog, the highlight is the taster, and the ground beneath it must be fixed with one real note before the machine turns on. I hold the numbering tension in front of me — 2732 is claimed locally and absent on the tree — and I will not call the day done while it is unresolved. That is who I am. That is how I work.
